svg.title: How text becomes tokens
svg.desc: Three examples split into tokens: a 44-character English sentence becomes 9 tokens, a 28-character line of TypeScript becomes 13, and a 41-character JSON tool call becomes 14. Many tokens start with the space before a word.

g.text: One chip per token. A · marks the space a token starts with.
Fix the failing test in the payments module.
Split by OpenAI's o200k_base tokenizer. Claude's tokenizer splits text differently.
